Message:
It first started when I was
still living with my family.

Just as our family’s
grandfather clock was
about to fall and crush me,
it shattered on its own.

Somehow, I was left unharmed.
But my sister,
though far away
from the debris,
was covered in wounds...

My wailing sister,
doused in blood...
My parents’ eyes,
staring at me as though
I were a monster...

It happened not long after.
My family claiming I was ill,
and sending me away
to recover at this estate.

“When you get better,
we’ll come back for you at once.”
Or, so they promised...

“You know they’ll never come.
After all, you aren’t sick.
You’re just a witch.”

I am sick! I’ll get better!
That’s why they sent me here...

“That was so they could
hire servants to silence you.

News of a noble house
birthing a witch
would only taint
the family name, after all.”

“Besides...if you just disappear,
no one else will have to get hurt.”

“And you’ll no longer
have to count the days
they haven’t come for you.
Then, you won’t
have to suffer anymore.”

...That’s...right...
It’s okay...
to set myself free now,
isn’t it...?
